after_investment.notes: Preliminary insolvency in March 2025, insolvency administrator a month later (Forbes CZ interview 2026-02-03); investors' recovery described as practically nil. The PitchBook-hinted 2025-03-10 'exit' fits the insolvency better than a sale; unconfirmed. Campiri was bought back by Nomiverse (L. Janousek) from the insolvency estate without VC money.

caveats: Forbes CZ (2022-06-20) precedes the German release (2022-07-21) by one month; T0 uses the earlier.
Merger date conflicts: 2024-02-19 announcement vs 'April 2024' in the interview.
